sections.heading: A summer of Sunflower play
sections.html:
What does every child need this year? A summer of Sunflower play, each day! Old-fashioned summer fun. Nature exploration. Time with friends. Experimenting with art and science.

This summer we’ll be offering seven individual weeks of Summer Seedlings Camp for children ages 3–6. Camp is a half-day program; morning or afternoon sessions are available.

“Creative play is like a spring that bubbles up from deep within a child.”
– Joan Almon

image.alt: Summer camp at Sunflower Creative Arts, July 2016

sections.heading: Registration and payment
sections.html:
• Unlike our other programs, Summer Camp registration is first come, first served, so it’s important to register as soon as possible to reserve your child’s spot!
  • A non-refundable deposit of $25 per week for half-day sessions or $50 per week for full-day sessions is required upon sign-up to reserve a spot. This deposit will secure your child’s place and will be applied toward your camp fee.
  • Camp balances are due by May 15, 2027. If enrolling after May 15, camp balances are due within one week of registration.
  • Please note that if enrolling after May 15, 2027, payment for camp is due within 7 days of registration or before your child’s first week of camp, whichever comes first. As long as payment is received before the start of your child’s registered camp week, their spot will remain secured. If payment is not received by the beginning of your child’s camp week, we may not be able to hold their spot.
  • Sessions may be cancelled if minimum enrollment requirements are not met.
  • All medical forms must be completed and submitted no later than June 1, 2027. If registering after June 1, all forms are due prior to the start date of your child’s camp session.

Please note: Families must be up to date with payment plans for current Sunflower classes in order to register for summer camp. Please contact us to bring your account current before registering.

items.title: Camp withdrawal and refund policy
items.html:
Registration deposit fees of $25/week are non-refundable. Should you need to withdraw from one or more sessions of camp once fees are paid, you will need to notify Sunflower in writing.

Refunds will be issued as follows:

  • If you notify Sunflower no later than 2 weeks (14 days) prior to your child’s first day of their first camp session (if enrolled in more than one session), you will receive a refund of your paid program fees, minus the deposit fee and a 5% administrative charge.
  • If you notify Sunflower 1–13 days from your child’s first camp day, you will receive a refund of paid program fees, minus the deposit fee and a 10% administrative charge.
  • If you notify Sunflower after your child’s camp session has started, the current camp week will not be refunded; however, any following weeks will be refunded with the above administrative charge structure (minus deposit fee and either a 5% charge for 2 or more weeks’ notice, or a 10% charge for less than 2 weeks’ notice).

*Special exceptions (medical and family emergency) will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
